AI-Native Engineer / AI Agent Engineer




Location: Hyderabad, India
Experience: 02 years; Freshers and final-year students welcome
Department: AI / Engineering
Employment Type: Full-time




Role Summary

We are looking for a curious AI-Native Engineer / AI Agent Engineer to build practical AI solutions for financial products and internal business teams. You will work on AI agents, automation, LLM integrations, RAG applications, and AI-powered workflows.

What You Will Do

Build AI assistants, AI agents, and automation workflows.
Integrate LLMs with APIs, databases, and internal systems.
Build agents that can retrieve information, reason through tasks, and securely call tools and APIs.
Develop RAG applications using product documentation, policies, and company knowledge.
Build AI capabilities for banking, wallets, exchange, cards, payments, KYC/KYB, and compliance.
Build internal AI tools for:

Code review and documentation
Debugging and test generation
QA and regression testing
Infrastructure and DevOps support
Customer support
Business operations and reporting
Automate workflows such as support triage, onboarding, reconciliation, and partner integrations.
Create AI evaluation, monitoring, guardrails, audit logs, and human-approval workflows.
Research new AI models and agent frameworks and turn useful ideas into working products.
Work closely with product managers, developers, designers, testers, compliance, and operations teams.



Required Skills



Strong programming fundamentals, preferably in Python.
Basic knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript.
Understanding of LLMs and Generative AI.
Prompt engineering and structured outputs.
Function calling and tool calling.
Basic understanding of AI agents and agentic workflows.
RAG, embeddings, and vector databases.
REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, Git, SQL, and basic backend development.
Understanding of authentication and authorization.
Ability to write basic unit and integration tests.
Good problem-solving, communication, and learning skills.



Good to Have



FastAPI, Pydantic, PostgreSQL, or pgvector.
LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or Semantic Kernel.
OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or open-source model APIs.
MCP servers and workflow orchestration.
React and TypeScript.
Docker, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, AWS, or Redis.
AI evaluation and observability tools such as Langfuse or OpenTelemetry.
Basic understanding of data privacy, PII protection, prompt injection, AI security, and audit logging.
Interest in fintech, banking, payments, crypto, compliance, or financial products.



Who We Are Looking For




Freshers and early-career engineers with:

AI, ML, Computer Science, or IT backgrounds.
Strong programming fundamentals.
Curiosity about AI and emerging technologies.
Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to learn quickly and work independently.
Personal, academic, internship, hackathon, or open-source AI projects.



Strong Advantage If You Have Built



An AI agent
A RAG application
An AI chatbot connected to APIs
An AI coding assistant
An AI QA or testing tool
Any tool-calling or workflow-automation application



What We Value




We value practical skills and problem-solving more than certificates. You should be able to explain how you would use AI to solve a business problemand when traditional software, rules, or human approval would be safer.

This is not a traditional machine-learning research role. You will build and integrate AI into real-world products and business processes at the intersection of:

AI + Agents + Banking + Crypto + Payments + Compliance + Automation

Key Skills

Python, LLMs, Generative AI, AI Agents, RAG, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, REST APIs, Vector Databases, LangGraph, LangChain, AI Automation, AI Security

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled and innovative Generative AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy AI-powered applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and agentic AI frameworks. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Python, AI/ML concepts, prompt engineering, vector databases, and cloud-native deployment architectures. The role involves building scalable GenAI solutions such as AI chatbots, copilots, intelligent search systems, document processing platforms, and AI automation workflows.


Responsibilities

Design and develop Generative AI applications using LLMs such as GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, or Mistral
Build and optimize RAG pipelines using embeddings and vector databases
Develop AI copilots, chatbots, document intelligence systems, and multi-agent workflows
Implement prompt engineering, function/tool calling, and AI orchestration frameworks
Fine-tune and evaluate foundation models for enterprise use cases
Integrate GenAI capabilities with APIs, databases, enterprise systems, and cloud platforms
Build scalable backend services using Python and FastAPI
Deploy and monitor AI applications on cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP
Implement LLMOps/MLOps practices including model monitoring, observability, governance, and evaluation
Collaborate with product managers, data engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver AI solutions
Ensure responsible AI practices including security, hallucination mitigation, and data privacy


Requirements

Technical Skills

Strong programming skills in Python
Hands-on experience with LLMs and GenAI ecosystems
Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI APIs, Hugging Face, AutoGen
Knowledge of RAG Architecture
Prompt Engineering
Embeddings
Vector Databases
AI Agents
Experience with vector DBs such as Pinecone, FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus
Understanding of ML/DL fundamentals and Transformer architecture
Experience with cloud services: AWS Bedrock / SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, GCP Vertex AI
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines
Knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases


Preferred Skills

Experience in fine-tuning LLMs using LoRA / QLoRA / PEFT
Exposure to multimodal AI systems
Knowledge of AI evaluation frameworks and observability tools
Experience with GPU optimization and inference tuning
Understanding of AI governance and responsible AI practices
Exposure to autonomous and agentic AI systems
